children: Kuwait’s Combined Group Contracting Company has been awarded a 9.7 million Kuwaiti dinar ($31.6 million) contract by Kuwait Oil Company (KOC) for repair and revamping services at production facilities in West Kuwait.

The award relates to Tender No. REP: 2143229, titled Provision of Repair & Revamping Services for the Production Facilities in West Kuwait Areas, the Kuwait stock exchange-listed company said in a disclosure.
KOC is the project owner, and the contract has an execution period of five years.
According to the company's disclosure, Combined Group expects the contract to generate operating profits that will be recognised in its financial statements over the execution period.
(Writing by Majda Muhsen; Editing by Anoop Menon)
